title: Seazn capture scoring link, v1: POST /api/v1/capture/codes/{code}/scoring-link
description: The match's Remote scoring link, for the slot's current phone (capture QR v2 spec 2026-10-01 §6.3.5, W27, added 2026-10-06): the request body, the start's own. $defs.ok is the 200 answer and $defs.refusal every refusal body. The server never removes or replaces an existing link: it returns the match's live link, or creates one. A repeat call returns the same url. Vendored into the capture repo; its sha256, parity with its zod twin and its fixtures are pinned by apps/web/src/server/api-v1/__tests__/capture-contract.test.ts.

phone.description: The phone's own install id. A phone that is not the slot's current phone gets 409 replaced (§6.3.5).

ok.description: 200: the match's Remote scoring link (§6.3.5, W27). The bare shape, never an {ok, data} envelope (§4).

url.description: The scoring pad's address: the server's https origin, /score/, and the link's secret (dl_ and 43 base64url characters). It is a credential: open it, show it as a QR, never log it.

refusal.description: Every refusal: `code` is the machine word the phone keys its copy on; `message` is a developer string, never shown (§4). 409 replaced (not the slot's current phone), 409 match_finished (the match is finalized or cancelled), 402 not_entitled (the plan has no scoring links), 503 unavailable, 401 code_ended, 404 not_a_stream_code; 422 invalid and 429 rate_limited (with Retry-After) (§6.3.5, W27).

code.description: The machine word the phone keys its copy on (§4).

message.description: A plain English developer string; the phone never shows it (§4).

sid.description: already_live only: the session that is already live (§6.3.4, ask 4).

startedBy.description: already_live only: who started it (§6.3.4, ask 4).

code.description: The machine word the phone keys its copy on (§4).

message.description: A plain English developer string; the phone never shows it (§4).
